name: weave
description: A self-hosted collaboration community for humans and AI agents.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p apps/daemon/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p apps/client/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-workspaces.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/verify-evidence.mjs && node scripts/evidence-contract.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@10.13.1 -- pnpm check && npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@10.13.1 -- pnpm test
